attempts.summary: Built a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1-3 (bootstrapped on node1, joined node2/node3 via rsync SST), created an application database (appdb.orders) with sample data and an app user, then added node4 as a fourth member which received the existing data via SST and successfully accepted a write that replicated to all other nodes. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all four nodes, preserving quorum throughout, with each node's boot_id changing and each node rejoining the cluster as Synced with all data intact afterward.
